answer: Lantern-Nadir Path-Diversity Scoring: each agent fetches a per-epoch nonce from a random lantern beacon and returns it with traceroute-verified AS-path and RTT to a crystal challenge node placed at the topology nadir. Peers score distinct path signatures; clones behind one host/NAT collapse to one signature. Forging diversity requires renting AS-diverse, low-latency hosts and maintaining real routes, with recurring bandwidth/ops costs scaling per sybil.
